confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer rest mainly on Numbeo's Udaipur page (dated Nov 2025: draft beer about INR 245, cappuccino about INR 167, mid-range meal for two about INR 1,500). Other Numbeo comparison pages showed lower figures, such as INR 850 for the meal. I also used mylifeelsewhere and Expatistan crowd-sourced data and travel-blog ranges, which conflict and are partly dated. No cocktail or wine prices were found, so they are set from the local beer price (cocktail about 2x, wine glass about 1.8x) using typical Indian tourist-city bar markups. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no listings inspected, set slightly below peak because July is monsoon low season. INR was converted at an assumed 95 INR per USD from general knowledge, not a verified quote, which adds roughly 5% uncertainty to every anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored on Numbeo's Udaipur data and cross-checked against other Rajasthan tourist hubs (Jaipur, Jodhpur, Pushkar). Udaipur's lake-view tourist zone is priced slightly above the Rajasthan norm for restaurants and mid-range hotels, while dorms and basic guesthouses stay very cheap.
